provenance.source: Uploaded LLC_Transformer.mat: named circuit containers, windings, packing and decoded interleaving stack
provenance.note: Preserves 3 circuits, 6 winding names/turns and layer order. All field currents start at 0 A for explicit selection. Uses overall 35 mm windows; normalized 22.82 mm conflicts. Litz bundle diameters 4.68/4.40 mm come from the separate Leakeage_computation.m example because saved strand-only geometry does not specify an external bundle diameter. Clearance is explicitly 0.5 mm. Nameplate entries include original test values; review before use. Bobbin type/dimensions are not a full CAD reconstruction.

builder.workflow_note: Imported named circuit/winding definitions; review source geometry and litz bundle assumptions.

notes: Frequency, temperature, conductivity and nameplate data are retained; the solve is magnetostatic with the selected permeability/B–H curve. No AC or thermal material scaling.
Extended 3D budget selected: up to 120,000 tetrahedra / 24,000 nodes. Solves and a full multiwinding matrix can take substantially longer and require more memory.
3D winding sections are closed ideal rectangular sheets at the mean radius. Copper thickness affects their placement and display envelope; no individual 3D turns are solved.
Named circuits contain independently excited windings. Only sections of the same electrical winding are connected in series; primary and secondary currents remain independent.
builder_summary.analytic_leakage_note: Balanced ampere-turn, one-dimensional window-energy estimate for the first circuit. Uniform common winding height; no fringing/end effects. Compare with FEM short-circuit inductance.
